tools.name: orchestrator_capabilities
tools.title: Get orchestration capabilities
tools.description: List providers, models, options, and runtime modes for `delegate_task`. Short list. `search` finds others. Any catalog model works.

tools.name: t3_thread_read
tools.title: Read a T3 thread
tools.description: Read any thread by id. `messages` (default): user and assistant messages and plans. `activity`: all timeline items. Keep reads small: low `limit` and `maxCharsPerItem`. Page with `afterPosition=nextPosition`. Cut-off text: `itemId` with `textOffset=nextTextOffset`. Reading a child's final result marks it delivered. In your reply, name it as its `link` verbatim.

tools.name: t3_thread_send
tools.title: Send to a T3 thread
tools.description: Send a message to any thread. The target cannot run with broader modes than yours. `mode:'auto'` starts an idle thread, steers a running turn, or queues. `queue`: new turn. `steer`: mid-turn update. `restart`: interrupt and restart. A send to a finished child thread starts a fresh task and returns its `taskId`. In your reply, name it as its `link` verbatim.

tools.name: t3_thread_send_attachments
tools.description: Send uploaded attachments as a new message to a thread. No retry key. Target modes cannot exceed yours. Success does not mean the provider read them or finished.

tools.name: t3_thread_launch
tools.description: Create one new top-level thread, bound to its workspace before the agent starts. Task in `message`. Omit `projectId`, model and modes to inherit yours (outside a thread, pass `projectId` or `scratch`); modes cannot exceed yours. After an error or lost reply, retry with the same `clientRequestId`. Follow it with `t3_thread_read` or `t3_thread_wait`. Mention it with its `link`.

scratch.description: No project: a new Scratch folder. Not with `projectId` or `workspaceStrategy`.

workspaceStrategy.description: 'worktree': new checkout from `baseRef`. 'existing_worktree': bind `worktreePath`, a project worktree. 'root': project checkout, the default, not your worktree. Stack: parent branch as `baseRef`, `startFromOrigin: false`. Uncommitted edits are not copied.

message.description: First prompt. Omit it and `attachments` for idle.
